title: Selfridges London has launched a huge Grand Theft Auto 6 store with 60+ items for sale | VGC
summary: Selfridges GTA 6 merchandise includes a £2,500 jacket; some items reportedly already sold out online…
text: Selfridges London has launched a huge Grand Theft Auto 6 store with 60+ items for sale | VGC Open main menu News Reviews Features Guides PlayStation Xbox Nintendo PC Gaming Mobile Login Zelda Gold Skulltulas Zelda: Ocarina of Time guides New Game Release Dates Search VGC Login with Patreon First for Video Game News Follow VGC Selfridges London has launched a huge Grand Theft Auto 6 store with 60+ items for sale Selfridges GTA 6 merchandise includes a £2,500 jacket; some items reportedly already sold out online Video Game News 9th Nov 2026 / 10:07 am Posted by Andy Robinson London’s Selfridges has launched a GTA 6 pop-up store featuring more than sixty items of merchandise, including a £2,500 jacket. The GTA 6 activation opened at the Selfridges London Bond Street and Manchester shops on Monday morning and will run until November 28. The outside of the London store has been lit in GTA 6 colors, and shop displays themed around the game, including a fictional sports car in one of its window displays. Simultaneously, the merchandise items went on sale via Selfridges’ online store on Monday morning, with queues of more than 100,000 people at the time of publishing this story, with some items said to be sold out. The Selfridges GTA merchandise includes t-shirts, jackets, caps, bags and mugs, as well as GTA 6-themed dart boards, pins, basketball sets, keychains, luggage tags, and more. Notably, more than half of the merchandise on sale is said to be exclusive to Selfridges, including the £2,500 Grand Theft Auto 6 Varsity Jacket. GTA VI Keychain £8 GTA VI I Heart VC Keychain £8 GTA VI shot glass £5 The Selfridges takeover is the latest activation in Grand Theft Auto 6’s global marketing campaign, which has seen the Rockstar Games title take over various cities around the world, most notably Miami, which the game’s fictional Vice City is based on. Over the past month, Rockstar has been quietly transforming the real-life city of Miami into GTA 6’s Vice City to promote the game, with the opening of in-game restaurant chains, advertisements for Weazel News, sports cars, and more. As part of Rockstar’s announced promotion, NBA team Miami Heat is set to rebrand as ‘Vice City’ as part of an event dubbed “A Night In Vice City,” which will take place on the eve of GTA 6’s launch on November 18, when the Heat will take the court as “Vice City”. Grand Theft Auto 6 will be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, and will be the studio’s first major new single-player release since Red Dead Redemption 2 , which arrived on PS4 and Xbox One in 2018.
